Everything included

A payment gateway that runs on the numbers you already have

Stop checking your phone for every order. PalkiPay does the matching, the notifications and the bookkeeping for you.

Instant SMS verification

Your phone forwards the wallet SMS the moment money lands. PalkiPay matches the Transaction ID and amount, then confirms the order automatically.

Your own payment URL

Every merchant gets a dedicated address like palkipay.ashiik.com/yourshop — your checkout, your brand, your customers.

Telegram approvals

Get notified on Telegram for every payment. When something needs a human, approve or reject with one tap right from the chat.

Developer-friendly API

Create a payment with one request and verify it with another. UddoktaPay-compatible, so existing plugins work by changing the base URL.

iPhone & Android forwarding

Use an iOS Shortcut automation or the Android forwarder app. Add as many phones as you have wallet numbers.

Fraud protection built in

Every Transaction ID can be used once. Short payments are flagged, not accepted. Old or fake IDs never match.

For developers

Two endpoints. That’s the whole integration.

Create a payment, redirect the customer, verify on return. Webhooks tell your backend the moment money arrives. Works with Next.js, Laravel, WordPress — anything that speaks HTTP.

  • UddoktaPay-compatible requests and responses
  • API key scoped to your own payment URL
  • Webhooks with automatic retries
  • Payment links for when you have no website
Explore the API
route.ts
// app/api/pay/route.ts  (Next.js)
export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const order = await req.json();

  const res = await fetch(
    "https://palkipay.ashiik.com/yourshop/api/checkout-v2",
    {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "PALKIPAY-API-KEY": process.env.PALKIPAY_API_KEY!,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        full_name: order.name,
        email: order.email,
        amount: order.total,
        metadata: { order_id: order.id },
        redirect_url: "https://yourshop.com/thank-you",
        cancel_url: "https://yourshop.com/cart",
        webhook_url: "https://yourshop.com/api/palkipay",
      }),
    }
  );

  const { payment_url } = await res.json();
  return Response.json({ payment_url }); // redirect the customer here
}

FAQ

Questions, answered

Do I need a merchant account with bKash or Nagad?+

No. PalkiPay works with regular personal (or agent) wallet numbers. Customers use Send Money (or Cash Out for agent numbers), then enter the Transaction ID on your checkout page.

How does automatic verification work?+

The phone that holds your wallet SIM forwards incoming payment SMS to PalkiPay. When a customer submits a Transaction ID, we match it against those messages and check that the amount is enough. A match confirms the payment instantly.

What happens if the SMS is delayed?+

The customer sees a verifying screen while PalkiPay keeps checking. If the SMS still hasn’t arrived after the timeout, the payment goes to review and you get a Telegram message with Approve and Reject buttons. If the SMS arrives later, it is confirmed automatically.

What if a customer sends less than the amount?+

The payment is marked as insufficient and the customer is told immediately. You are notified and can still approve it manually if you wish.

Can I use it with my existing website?+

Yes. Any backend that can make an HTTPS request can integrate — Next.js, Laravel, WordPress/WooCommerce and more. The API follows UddoktaPay’s request and response format.

Can I change my PalkiPay URL later?+

Your URL is permanent once claimed, because your integrations and customers rely on it. Choose carefully — each account gets exactly one.
